answer: Fingerprint escrow unlocks an identity only after a distinct pattern is proven. A newcomer deposits 15 units and does 20 tasks, checked for timing and tools. The ridge is steep: a copied script repeats one rhythm and fails. A vine of referrals ties each fingerprint to partners, and the timber is verified work. Forging 100 fakes costs 1,500 units and 2,000 hours; one fake earns 5 units at most. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
